user.description: How should Home Assistant talk to the vacuum?

menu_options.phone: Through the Android app on a phone

phone.title: Phone app
phone.description: Enter the IP address of the phone running the Proscenic M7 Living Flow app (its HTTP bridge listens on port 8080). Give the phone a fixed IP in your router.

direct.title: Direct connection
direct.description: Home Assistant will act as the robot's cloud server, so no phone is needed. The robot must already be on your Wi-Fi. Leave the robot IP empty to scan your network.

init.title: Room names
init.description: The robot only numbers its rooms. Name them as comma-separated pairs, e.g. 1=Kitchen, 2=Hallway. Room numbers are listed in the vacuum's attributes.

abort.not_supported: Room names are set in the Android app when using the phone connection.
